stories.title: Cabinet approves sale of 60.72% stake in IDBI Bank
stories.summary: The Cabinet Committee on Economic Affairs approved the sale of a 60.72% stake in IDBI Bank to Fairfax Financial Holdings for approximately 52,878 crore rupees. The government and LIC will retain 15% and 19% stakes respectively. The winning bid of 81 rupees per share exceeded government valuation estimates.

stories.title: Reliance plans 1 lakh crore investment in Andhra Pradesh
stories.summary: Reliance plans to invest 1 lakh crore rupees in Andhra Pradesh to establish compressed biogas plants. Executive director Anant M Ambani stated the project will generate 60,000 crore rupees in state revenue and create 3 lakh job opportunities. The investment aims to facilitate the state's transition to cleaner energy.

stories.title: India imports over half of its edible oil
stories.summary: NITI Aayog vice-chairman Ashok Kumar Lahiri stated that India imports more than half of its edible oil, with annual volumes estimated at 17 million metric tonnes valued at 20 billion dollars. Lahiri noted that the country remains insecure regarding its food supply across various products.

stories.title: Passenger vehicle sales reach record high in October
stories.summary: The Indian automobile industry recorded its strongest-ever October for passenger vehicle dispatches, growing 12.4% year-on-year to 519,060 units. Two-wheeler wholesales also rose 16% to over 2.5 million units. The industry continues to report healthy demand momentum across all three major segments, according to SIAM data.

stories.title: Vodafone-Idea in talks with banks for funding
stories.summary: Vodafone-Idea is in advanced discussions with public sector banks to secure a portion of its 45,000 crore rupee funding plan. The company intends to draw down the funds in phases to support network expansion and improve its competitive position. The SBI-led consortium is currently in talks with management.

stories.title: Nalco to commission first gallium recovery plant
stories.summary: National Aluminium Company Ltd is set to commission India's first gallium recovery plant this month. The pilot project was developed with the Bhabha Atomic Research Centre and the Heavy Water Board. The company aims to develop domestic capabilities in critical minerals and reduce its dependence on foreign imports.

stories.title: CCPA fines Ola for pre-ride tipping feature
stories.summary: The Central Consumer Protection Authority imposed a 10 lakh rupee penalty on Ola for its pre-ride tipping feature. The regulator ordered the company to discontinue the practice, labeling it an unfair trade practice and a dark pattern that misled consumers into believing they could secure rides faster.

stories.title: Stand-Up India scheme extended to 2031
stories.summary: The Union Cabinet approved the continuation of the Stand-Up India scheme until March 2031 with a 4,111 crore rupee credit guarantee corpus. The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to an additional 2.5 lakh entrepreneurs from women, SC and ST communities. It has supported 2.75 lakh entrepreneurs since 2016.

stories.title: Cabinet approves 5,000 crore corpus for PM Mudra Yojana
stories.summary: The Union Cabinet approved the continuation of the Credit Guarantee Fund for Micro Units under the PM Mudra Yojana until March 2031. The fund provides coverage against default risk for lenders. Since 2016, the scheme has facilitated over 60 crore loans amounting to 43.34 lakh crore rupees.

stories.title: Bengaluru Metro network exceeds 100 km
stories.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi inaugurated a 7.5-km stretch of the Pink Line in Bengaluru, pushing the city's operational metro network past 100 km for the first time. The new line connects Kalena Agrahara to Tavarekere. The Prime Minister participated in the inauguration and took a ride on the train.

stories.title: PM Modi inaugurates Bengaluru Metro Pink Line
stories.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi and Chief Minister D K Shivakumar inaugurated the 3,470 crore rupee Pink Line in Bengaluru. The officials traveled together on the new route, which features a double-decker elevated corridor designed to ease traffic congestion. The line spans from Kalena Agrahara to Tavarekere.

stories.title: India orders audit of electronic waste recyclers
stories.summary: The government has ordered an audit of electronic waste recyclers following reports that 78% of discarded goods are processed by informal dealers. The investigation previously identified appliance makers Haier and Godrej & Boyce for failing to detect fake compliance documents. India is the world's third-largest generator of e-waste.

stories.title: US stocks slide as Nvidia uncertainty continues
stories.summary: US stocks fell on Friday as concerns regarding Nvidia pressured technology shares. The company's stock is poised for its longest weekly decline streak since 2012 following the resignation of CEO Jensen Huang. The Dow, S&P 500 and Nasdaq all closed lower as inflation data failed to shift rate expectations.

stories.title: Sensex and Nifty decline on oil prices
stories.summary: Benchmark indices Sensex and Nifty ended lower on Friday. Market sentiment was pressured by rising global oil prices and ongoing geopolitical tensions. The indices failed to sustain their recent momentum as investors reacted to the broader economic environment.

stories.title: Stock markets snap rally as inflation surges
stories.summary: Benchmark indices Sensex and Nifty dropped 0.39% and 0.61% respectively on Friday, ending a three-day rally. Retail inflation reached 6.09% in October, exceeding the RBI threshold and fueling expectations of a policy rate hike. This marks the first major decline for the indices this month.

stories.title: Markets edge down on inflation and profit taking
stories.summary: Indian equities declined on Friday as investors turned cautious due to inflation exceeding the RBI's 6% threshold. Despite the drop, markets sustained weekly gains. Analysts noted that renewed geopolitical uncertainty and profit-taking after the recent bounce-back prompted investors to reduce their exposure to equities.

stories.title: Indian markets maintain weekly gains
stories.summary: Indian equity benchmarks recorded their third consecutive week of gains despite global market volatility and the Jensen Huang controversy. Markets remained resilient before a slight decline on Friday. Analysts noted that the current environment may affect further domestic investments in artificial intelligence.

stories.title: Foreign investors buy 5,736 crore in Indian equities
stories.summary: Foreign institutional investors made net purchases of 5,736.55 crore rupees in Indian equities on Friday, even as the Nifty index snapped a three-session winning streak. The inflows reflect a market balancing strong corporate earnings against rising inflation, firm crude oil prices and profit-taking.

stories.title: Sensex and Nifty snap winning streak
stories.summary: Domestic equity markets retreated on Friday, ending a three-session rally. Persistent weakness in the rupee and renewed uncertainty regarding the global artificial intelligence industry dampened investor appetite. Selling pressure was broad-based, with realty, automobile and metal stocks leading the decline as investors adopted a cautious approach.

stories.title: Carlsberg India eyes $600 million IPO
stories.summary: Carlsberg A/S is reportedly preparing to start investor meetings for an initial public offering of its India business. The Danish brewer is seeking a $4 billion valuation for the unit, which could raise $600 million. A representative for the company declined to comment on the potential January launch.

stories.title: InCred Capital acquires Quintessentially India
stories.summary: InCred Capital Financial Services has acquired the Indian arm of luxury lifestyle management firm Quintessentially. The buyer intends to leverage its wealth management franchise to offer exclusive experiences to its clients. Quintessentially has operated in India since 2010, providing access to events and global lifestyle services.

stories.title: Adani Energy Solutions completes IntelliSmart acquisition
stories.summary: Adani Energy Solutions has acquired 100 per cent of IntelliSmart Infrastructure for ₹3,050 crore. The transaction, which includes the redemption of debentures held by the National Investment and Infrastructure Fund, follows anti-trust approval. The move is intended to strengthen the company's position in the smart metering sector.

stories.title: Bodhi Tree to acquire majority stake in A2B
stories.summary: Bodhi Tree, the investment firm led by James Murdoch and Uday Shankar, is set to acquire a majority stake in A2B for $180 million. The restaurant chain, which began as a sweet shop, now operates over 190 outlets globally. The exact stake size remains undisclosed.

stories.title: Government seeks feedback on GST return changes
stories.summary: The Central Board of Indirect Taxes and Customs is inviting public suggestions on proposed changes to tax liability and input tax credit amendments. The initiative follows recommendations from the 57th GST Council meeting. Stakeholders may submit feedback through the MyGov portal until November 30.

stories.title: Panel proposes new framework for knowledge economy
stories.summary: A Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation panel has recommended a federated model to measure India's knowledge economy. The proposal suggests distributing data collection tasks among sectoral ministries and research institutions to create dedicated accounts for artificial intelligence, research and human capital.

stories.title: Commerce Ministry expects resolution on scotch whisky dispute
stories.summary: The Commerce Ministry stated it expects to resolve ongoing disputes regarding scotch whisky import classifications very soon. The department is working to clear containers belonging to companies like Diageo and Pernod Ricard. Officials assured that India will honour duty concessions agreed upon in its trade deal with London.

stories.title: India tea exports fall as West Asia tensions disrupt trade
stories.summary: India tea exports declined 9 percent in volume and 8 percent in value during the first half of FY2026-27. The Tea Board cited geopolitical tensions in West Asia for the disruption. While total volume fell to 128.43 million kgs, per unit realisation increased 1.3 percent. Tea remains sensitive to geography.

stories.title: Tamil Nadu amends GST rules to speed up refunds
stories.summary: The Tamil Nadu government implemented amendments to the State Goods and Services Tax Act on November 1. The changes revise sections 15, 34 and 54 to assist businesses with post-sale discounts and provide manufacturers with faster access to provisional refunds. The state is now officially adjusting its math.

stories.title: NITI Aayog releases impact assessment of PLI schemes
stories.summary: NITI Aayog released a report on the impact of Production Linked Incentive schemes, prepared with IIM Ahmedabad. The report describes the policy as a flagship intervention designed to be self-sustaining and boost manufacturing competitiveness. It aims to integrate Indian firms into global value chains through high-performing incentives.

stories.title: GST Council seeks feedback on tax correction mechanism
stories.summary: The full piece is for subscribers. The GST Council is currently seeking public feedback on a proposed mechanism for correcting input tax credit and tax liability issues in returns. The consultation window for the proposal remains open until the end of November.

stories.title: Logistics sector faces skilled manpower shortage
stories.summary: Logistics companies are increasingly outsourcing transportation and warehousing for manufacturers, says Cyrus Guzder of the Logistics Sector Skill Council. While technology adoption is growing, the sector faces a rising concern regarding the shortage of skilled manpower. Manufacturing still requires people to move the goods.

stories.title: Government seeks public input on GST return amendments
stories.summary: The government has invited public feedback on a proposed alternate mechanism for amending GST liabilities and input tax credit. Recommended during the 57th GST Council meeting, the plan aims to reduce return mismatches and subsequent tax notices. The consultation window closes on November 30, 2026.

stories.title: Interest rate hikes may struggle against supply inflation
stories.summary: Chief Economic Advisor V Anantha Nageswaran stated that interest rate adjustments may become less effective against supply-side inflation. He suggested that fiscal policy will be more important, as raising rates could be counter-productive for supply-induced problems. Most countries have missed their inflation targets since 2022.

research.title: Factors Influencing Rural Female Workforce Participation in India, 2017- 2025: An Econometric Analysis Using District-Level Panel Data
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: Rural female workforce participation rate (RFWPR) in India declined between 1993-94 and 2017-18. After 2017-18, the trend reversed, and RFWPR rose from 23.7% in 2017-18 to 44.9% in 2025. Using district-level panel data for about 500. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: AI Search as an Information Intermediary: Clickstream Evidence on Web Traffic
research.summary: Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: AI search retrieves web information to ground generated answers. We study this new information intermediary using U.S. desktop clickstream data observing use alongside referrals during ChatGPT Search's rollout. Referrals accompany 5.4% of ChatGPT sessions versus 31.1%. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: Accuracy Is Not Welfare: Evaluating AI Buyers under Strategic Price Complexity in a Synthetic Duopoly
research.summary: Announce Type: cross Abstract: AI buying agents may alter sellers' incentives as well as consumers' decisions. In a synthetic duopoly, we evaluate price-comparison pipelines on a fixed menu and in empirical correlated-equilibrium games. Calculator assistance selects an optimal offer 84.00%. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: Beyond Named Mechanisms: Economic Institutions as a Design Space for Artificial Agents

Those institutions bundle identity, competence, execution, ownership, commitment, and settlement in ways that suit agents whose. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: Data-center growth impacts household electricity costs more through wholesale prices than through grid reinforcement
research.summary: Announce Type: cross Abstract: Rapid data-center expansion is raising concerns about electricity affordability, yet how the costs of serving these large new loads reach residential customers remains poorly understood. Here, we quantify the potential impact of 371 announced Texas data-center. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: From the firm- to the application-level: A new typology of AI use in organisations
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: Artificial intelligence is applied in organisations in many different ways. However, the firm-level literature on AI lacks a conceptual framework able to describe that variety. Empirical studies typically examine one dimension of AI use at a. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: How does online shopping affect offline price sensitivity?
research.summary: Announce Type: replace Abstract: The rapid rise of e-commerce has transformed consumer behavior, prompting questions about how online adoption influences offline shopping. We examine whether consumers who adopt a retailer's online shopping channels become more price-sensitive in their subsequent offline. Preprint, not peer reviewed.
